pr_title: Handle login API state changes in `UserProfileOverlay`
pr_body:
Fixes #25503, along with handling the re-fetch required when a user logs in whilst on the overlay (similar to the work done in #22122).

I have renamed a few parameters so they don't clash with the new fields, but I am terrible with naming so any suggestions for them would be appreciated!

issue_context.title: User profile loads indefinitely if logged out
issue_context.body:
### Type

Cosmetic

### Bug description

I've checked with other overlays (such as chat, beatmap listing, etc.) and they all just show the clickable "login to view" message with no loading in front of it.

For some reason, the user overlay has a constant loading spinner that prevents the user from clicking on the "please log in" message. Nothing special, but it looks wrong.

You can easily achieve this with the following steps:
- download a beatmap (while logged in)
- log out (which happened in my case after an update for some reason, on mobile)
- restart the game (probably not necessary, but just to have the fresh, non-logged-in experience in case you need to log out)
- go to the carousel and click on a mapper name from the wedge

### Screenshots or videos

![Screenshot_20231119-014837](https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/43073074/fe897b76-be2a-46ed-99f2-3707ebb15a4d)


### Version

2023.1114.1-lazer

### Logs

(It doesn't permit me to access the logs from the phone for some reason, I will be able to do it from the computer but in a while. Please ask if needed.)
comments:
I believe the loading state regressed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/22006/commits/a124c967dfd96a671640b24734f9e9c10d574f56, the loading overlay only gets hidden on request success.

Worth noting that logging in whilst on this screen does not load the user profile, it probably needs something like this https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/166518db7a84ce5619b7ee74a014651dd9256f22/osu.Game/Overlays/BeatmapSetOverlay.cs#L85-L90

I've had a look at this today, but I'm sure someone will beat me to a decent fix!

review_comments:
Not sold by this change. The ruleset was being passed to the callback here intentionally, to isolate it from the ambient state of the user profile overlay. To illustrate, see following scenario:

- user profile overlay initiates request for profile of user A in osu! ruleset
- user profile overlay initiates request for profile of user B in mania ruleset
- request for profile of user A completes here, but the user profile overlay's `ruleset` field is now mania and not osu!, which is incorrect.

Maybe this won't ever cause an actual issue, but I have seen this go wrong enough times to be uncomfortable when seeing another instance of such a pattern.
Have reverted this back to passing the ruleset into the callback - definitely feels more correct here
